name: Route Finder
description: Analyze level structure and corridors, then search solo/two-player routes; pause-only controls and verified physics-tick macros.

auto-resume.name: Resume saved search
auto-resume.description: Find route restores this level search session when compatible. Disable to start a fresh search. Every attempt still starts from the beginning.

smooth-search.name: Lower search load
smooth-search.description: Reuse unchanged physics-step decisions and short action plans. Every new forecast completes its full horizon; no render-frame timeout or skipped input. Heavy scenes can still take longer.
